messages: Subject: Recap + scheduling: technical deep-dive for BioMedix (env + access items)

Hi Lena,

Great to speak earlier — thanks for the time. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can lock the technical deep-dive: 

- Goal: 60–75 minute technical session to validate architecture fit, run through inference throughput expectations, and confirm any environment or access requirements for a 2-week POC.
- Redwood attendees: myself (AE), Marissa (Solutions Engineer), Connor (Platform).
- BioMedix attendees we discussed: someone from MLOps, one infra/sysadmin, and procurement for scope/contract alignment.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue Feb 16, 10:00–11:15 AM PST
- Tue Feb 16, 2:00–3:15 PM PST
- Wed Feb 17, 9:00–10:15 AM PST

Can you confirm which slot works and who from your team will join? Also flag any required compliance/security contacts so we can include them. I’ll send a calendar invite once you pick a time and include a shared Google Meet link + a short mutual action plan (attached).

I’ve attached a draft MAP and a brief tech checklist (env access, sample traffic pattern, dataset constraints) — these are just for prep, we’ll finalize during the call.

Thanks — next message will contain the calendar invite once you confirm.

Best,
Priyom

pri@redwood.inference | +1 (415) 555-0129
